section.label: Governance structure
section.title: Leadership team
section.description: The authorities of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción are democratically elected in accordance with the University Statute, ensuring participatory and transparent governance.

a1.description: Highest authority of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción. Represents the institution before national and international bodies.

a2.description: Responsible for planning, supervising and evaluating the university's academic and research processes.

a3.description: Oversees the administrative, financial and asset management of the institution.

a4.description: Responsible for document management, administrative acts and coordination of collegiate governing bodies.

a5.description: Coordinates academic programs, admissions, registration and all aspects of the student academic journey.

a6.description: Manages economic resources, institutional budget, procurement and general services.

note: For up-to-date information about the authorities, please contact the General Secretariat of the Rectorate of the Universidad Nacional de Concepción, located in the city of Concepción, Paraguay.
